Record Class UserProfileDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
arkheim.client.domain.ports.dtos.UserProfileDto
public record UserProfileDto(UUID id, String username, String name, String email, String biography, LocalDateTime dateOfBirth, String pfpUrl, int followerCount, int followingCount, LocalDateTime createdAt, UUID pinnedPostId) extends Record
Client-side DTO mirroring the server's UserProfileResponse}. Returned by the user port when fetching a full profile.
